question: Which vessels were in Flensburg at 17:00 UTC on September 23?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT mmsi FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-09-23' AND lon BETWEEN 9.429 AND 9.457 AND lat BETWEEN 54.785 AND 54.818 AND ts > TIMESTAMP '2026-09-23 17:00:00' - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-23 17:00:00' ORDER BY mmsi

question: Which ships were docked in Heiligenhafen at 06:30 on 22 September?
